headline: Last session: Sensex slipped into red while Nifty gained 75 points; focus remains on dividends and upcoming support levels.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Sensex slipped into the red after the closing auction session (CAS) despite early gains.
Nifty 50 managed to gain 75 points, showing resilience in the broader market indices.
Geopolitical tensions rose following Houthi missile attacks on Saudi Aramco facilities in Riyadh.
Market sentiment was weighed down by uncertainty regarding the new EPFO wage ceiling impact.
whatHappening: Dividend-paying stocks like IRCTC, Dixon, and Titagarh Rail Systems saw increased investor interest.
Small-cap stocks witnessed mixed action as the Sensex and Nifty indices showed divergence.
Traders are focusing on the upcoming support levels for Nifty between September 21 and 25.
Paytm remains a key stock in focus for investors following recent market opening trends.
summary: On the last trading day, the Nifty gained 75 points while the Sensex closed in the red. Investors focused on dividend stocks like IRCTC and Dixon Technologies amid global geopolitical tensions. The market is currently closed for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, September 21.
